messages:
maria: quick flag from the q6_base onboarding run: elevated factual errors on the doc-summarization holdout. Delta ~+5% vs q5. Seems tied to int4 kernel on long windows.
devin: can you paste a failing example? short excerpt is fine.
maria: pasted two snippets in the S3 folder: s3://redwood-curation/sentinel/q6_onboard/1829994321/examples.txt (look for IDs D-4321, D-4339). model invents section headers and file names.
anita: thanks. do we know if this is quant-only or also appears in fp16?
maria: fp16 baseline ~1.8% error. q6_base int4 ~6.7%. int8 fallback sits at 2.9%.
chen: sounds like a quantization path regression. i'll try reproducing with the kernel tracing flags. command i'm going to run:
```
python scripts/run_eval.py --model q6_base --dataset sentinel_docs_long --quant int4 --trace-kernels
```
sylvia: for curation: recommend 150 focused golden candidates + 50 adversarial synthetic variants that append plausible headers (to catch invention).
devin: agree with synthetic adversarials. we should also tighten dedupe so we don't drop near-duplicates that expose the bug. current fuzzy threshold=0.9 is too strict. lower to 0.8?
anita: i'd rather use two-stage dedupe: token-ngram overlap <0.7 OR fuzzy <0.8 then keep for human review. saves labeler time but preserves edge cases.
maria: i've exported candidate pool: s3://redwood-curation/sentinel/q6_onboard/1829994321/candidates.parquet (includes fuzz_score + ngram_overlap).
ops-bot: Current labeler queue: 310 items. Avg throughput: 75/hr. To finish +200 surge with priority tag: ~2.9 hours.
chen: i'll spin up a quick dedupe pass using the two-stage rules and push filtered list to S3:
```
python tools/filter_candidates.py --in candidates.parquet --out for_labeling.csv --ngram 0.7 --fuzz 0.8
```
devin: add an instruction doc for labelers: label values = {HALLUCINATE, OK, UNCLEAR}. Provide examples and adjudication rules. Two-pass adjudication required (labeler + senior).
sylvia: i'm happy to be the senior adjudicator. schedule the batch as `q6-golden-surge-1829994321` and tag priority `golden-urgent`.
anita: also open an infra ticket to capture kernel mismatch traces: INF-9407. chen please attach trace output if you hit it.
chen: noted, will attach.
maria: i'll hold rollout until canary against new golden subset passes. need stakeholder note by EOD.
devin: i'll open a prompt-bank PR with adversarial generators (adds header-template augmentations). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/prompt-bank/pulls/1284
sylvia: labeler pool: i'll request 3 extra reviewers from seasonal backlog. @ops-bot please bump priority.
ops-bot: Labeler priority increased for prefix `eng-ml/golden`. Concurrency +3 applied. New estimated ETA for batch: 2.1 hours.
maria: action list: chen -> run kernel trace + dedupe; devin -> PR for adversarials; anita -> create labeling instructions + batch; sylvia -> adjudication + reviewer scheduling; ops-bot -> queue bump (done). i'll post a short stakeholder update in #product after we lock the golden subset. :raised_hands:
chen: starting trace run now. posting any error logs to INF-9407.
anita: creating batch `q6-golden-surge-1829994321` with 200 items. will include adjudicators field.
devin: PR opened for adversarial header augment (1284). tests included.
maria: thanks all. will follow up with initial labeling progress in ~1.5h.
